turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: A homemade salad sounds like a perfect, healthy lunch! And getting some guitar time in is always a great weekend activity. How are things going with your sister Ana's wedding coming up in November? That's right around the corner!

turns.text: Being an account coordinator at a logistics firm can be pretty hectic, especially with end-of-year shipping picking up, but I've managed to keep my weekends free so far.

turns.text: That's a huge win. Protecting your weekend time is so important when work gets demanding. Are you planning to fit in any rock climbing this weekend, or is it strictly a rest and music weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I might go to the climbing gym tomorrow, but today is definitely about resting up. I'm just going to enjoy the rest of my Saturday.
